title: Retire the old dashboard
goal: /dashboard/ leads to the workspace dashboard, and web/public/dashboard (index.html, live.js, dashboard.js, sw.js, manifest) and its tests are removed; the simple view stays
acceptance: /dashboard/ redirects to the workspace view and nerv open opens it; the old worker is replaced by one that unregisters itself, so installed apps move
Old dashboard files, their tests and docs mentions are removed (no dead code); every section's join test passes
The simple view (F-130-T16) is kept and still links to the full dashboard; only the old web/public/dashboard page is retired
privacy: Neutral invented sorties, devices and names only; tokens and pairing codes never in tests or logs.
escalation: A visible change in how a section looks or behaves goes to the owner

effort.basis: Estimated 2026-11-25: redirect, worker hand-over, deletions and doc updates. Not a measurement.
